recoveryRetryApp: The device security credential is unavailable. Close and reopen the app, then try again. Your existing wallet data has been kept.

recoveryBackups: Before removing any wallet data, verify that you have a recovery phrase or an independently usable exported backup for every wallet, including wallets saved under earlier network profiles. A copy of device-encrypted data alone cannot recover a wallet when its device credential is lost. Keep all wallet data if any recovery backup is missing.
recoveryNative: If retrying still fails and every wallet has a usable backup, open app Settings and choose Remove All Wallets. Complete the app's authentication and confirmation steps. This permanently removes all wallets and preserved earlier backups from this device. Once removal completes, import each wallet using its recovery backup.
settingsFallback: Open Settings from the app navigation to review recovery options.
recoveryBrowser: If retrying still fails, use a separate browser profile to import a recovery phrase or independently usable exported backup. Keep this browser profile and its wallet data until every wallet is recovered.
